name: wanderly-trip-planner
description: Interactive world-map trip planner: budget check, plans, Gemini assistant

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
